phenomenon_scale.label: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength
phenomenon_scale.note: Exact stored length is 1.12e-06 m (1.12 µm), the detail-scale wavelength named 1.1 µm in the slot brief.

predecessor.name: Cambrian stem lobopodian (lineage context; not a member of this one-step chronoseries)
predecessor.change: At 1.12 µm the predecessor leaves no countable pigment/microvillus spacing. N = 0 because the feature sits below a 10 µm preservation floor.

this_chronospecies.name: Euperipatoides rowelli
this_chronospecies.change: The living retina makes k_sigma a physiological eigenvalue. floor(100 µm / 1.12 µm) = 89 detail wavelengths fit across the eye.

paleobiology.what_changes_vs_predecessor_and_successo: No successor (extant terminus, chronoseries 1/1). Versus the Cambrian predecessor, the integer mode count at this scale changes from unresolved (N = 0) to N = 89, and the diffusion ratio Dv/Du = 22 belongs to the hydrated screening-pigment field rather than to a fossil impression. The detail wavelength stays finer than the 2.5 µm photoreceptor pitch; that separation is the content of this scale, not a copy of a coarser sibling slot.

equations: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + gamma * (a - u + u^2 v)
dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + gamma * (b - u^2 v)
governing_model.boundary_conditions: No-flux (Neumann) on the square retinal patch, implemented as a discrete cosine basis.
governing_model.dispersion: sigma(k) = largest real eigenvalue of gamma*J - k^2 diag(Du, Dv)
governing_model.k_delta_definition: k_delta^2 = gamma * (Dv*f_u + Du*g_v) / (2*Du*Dv), the minimizer of the determinant factor; equals k_sigma only at onset
governing_model.k_onset_definition: k_onset^2 = gamma * sqrt(det(J) / (Du*Dv)), the classical double-root Turing wavenumber

parameters.notes: gamma is the bisection value at which argmax sigma(k) = 2*pi*14 on the unit nondimensional domain, i.e. physical wavelength 1.12 µm. Dv/Du = 22 is specific to slot 3223.

empirical_claims.claim: Adult E. rowelli eyes are ocelli about 100 µm in diameter.
Photoreceptors are packed on a roughly hexagonal lattice with centre-to-centre distance 2–3 µm; the optical model uses about 2.5 µm.
The rhabdomeric microvillus layer is figured at a 1 µm scale bar, the anatomical regime of this detail wavelength.
Pigment cells are distinguished by pigment granules and the absence of a rhabdomere; they cup the retina.
The lens is approximately homogeneous with refractive index about 1.48–1.485.

transfer_boundary: No published paper measures a Turing wavelength of 1.12 µm in E. rowelli. The script reconstructs that wavelength by calibrating Schnakenberg k_sigma to the assigned detail scale, inside the anatomical regime described by Mayer 2006, Kirwan 2018, and Ljungholm & Nilsson 2021.
